snippet.title: Day & Night Cycle of 1666: Amsterdam | Gameplay Feature 3 | EA Launches Aug 25
snippet.description:
In the third gameplay feature video, co-founder and executive producer Jean-François Boivin offers the most in-depth look yet at the game's investigation mechanics as players hunt the mysterious Originals across Amsterdam. 

It also showcases combat, the day and night cycle, Noa's mystical abilities, Aaron's feline gameplay, and how both characters combine their unique skills to uncover hidden truths and restore the balance of the world. 


In-Game Footage  

-

Play the prologue now. 
Free on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/45... 

Epic Game Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/1666-am... 

Wishlist the full game and follow its development as it heads to PC Early Access on August 25, 2026.

-

About 1666: Amsterdam
A cycle is ending. Another one is beginning. Take part in Noa’s Commencement as she inherits the mantle of the Collector. Unravel a mystery that spans centuries. Choose the companion that will walk beside you. Follow the traces left behind in a city shaped by secrets, power, and memory. This is where everything begins.
